title: Flexible predictive models: recurrent networks against cognitive models
summary: A recurrent network fitted to choices against Q-learning variants and a linear baseline on a two-button learning task, compared by leave-one-subject-out prediction; what flexibility buys in prediction and what it costs in interpretation.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the outline below names its scope and sources.

preparation.description: Read the abstract of Dezfouli et al. (2019).
Read the task: a two-button instrumental learning task with reward probabilities changing by block.
Read the baseline models (ql, qlp, gql and lin).
